summary: This Form 6-K reports a registered direct offering by Core AI Holdings, Inc., a foreign private issuer, under its existing shelf registration statement. The company sold 1,969,444 common shares at $0.90 each and pre-funded warrants for up to 3,975,000 shares at $0.89999 each, raising gross proceeds of ~$5.4 million. The warrants are immediately exercisable at $0.00001 with cashless exercise. D. Boral Capital served as placement agent for a 7% fee. The offering closed on June 11, 2026, with a 30-day lockup on further equity issuances. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
